verdict.rationale: Kitty ships an official, first-party remote-control CLI: the docs say kitty "can be controlled from scripts or the shell prompt" to open windows, send text input to any window, and change titles, and a probe confirms the CLI is documented on the remote-control page. The ssh kitten also forwards remote-control sockets to remote hosts. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI affordances (e.g. machine-readable output or AI-workflow docs), independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI's use in scripted/agentic workflows.
